title: A Trilogy of AI Safety Frameworks: Paths from Facts and Knowledge Gaps to Reliable Predictions and New Knowledge
reasoning: The paper proposes a trilogy of frameworks for AI safety (P2K, AIIS, and Knowledge Gaps) with a primary focus on biomedical applications. While it mentions the ethical implications of AI and hallucinations in language models, and references a book titled 'The Ethical Algorithm,' it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or beliefs.
